what: Capital One Shopping reports that in 2025, 93.539 million consumers purchased items from Etsy (consolidated), 5.90 million (7%) were habitual buyers, repeat buyers decreased 2.01% year-over-year, average annual spend was $127.40, approximately 40% of GMS came from habitual buyers, and mobile users purchased 45% of consolidated GMS (up 7.14% YoY).
verbatim_snippet: "In 2025, 93.539 million consumers purchased items from Etsy. An estimated 5.90 million Etsy consumers (7%) are habitual buyers. There was a 2.01% YoY decrease in repeat buyers in 2025. The average Etsy consumer spends $127.40 on the marketplace in a year. Approximately 40% of GMS in 2025 came from habitual buyers, down 2.44% YoY. Mobile users (through the Etsy app) purchased 45% of consolidated GMS in 2025, up 7.14% YoY."
notes: Secondary aggregation source citing SEC filings, Statista, and SimilarWeb. Consolidated numbers include Depop. Fetch status uncertain; degraded to provisional. Average spend of $127.40 is consolidated (vs. Etsy marketplace-only GMS/buyer of $121).
